title: A reflective infographic exploring how pain can be transformed into creativity, meaning, and contribution instead of being passed forward through unconscious repetition. This piece examines emotional metabolization, expression, insight generation, and the process of turning difficult experiences into something that helps both yourself and others. A reminder that healing is not about denying pain—it is about transforming it. #healing-journey #creative-expression #personal-growth #self-awareness #post-traumatic-growth
